parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The ID of the whitelist rule. If you do not specify this parameter, a whitelist rule is created.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description:
The name of the alert.

*   Set the value to ALL, which indicates all alert types.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: The field that you want to use in the whitelist rule.

parameters.name: FieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the field that you want to use in the whitelist rule.

parameters.name: Operator
parameters.description:
The logical operator that you want to use in the whitelist rule.

*   Set the value to strEqual, which indicates the equality operator (=).

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The feature to which this operation belongs.

*   Set the value to agentless, which indicates the agentless detection feature.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The type of the assets on which you want the whitelist rule to take effect. Valid values:

*   ALL: all assets
*   SELECTION_KEY: selected assets

parameters.name: TargetValue
parameters.description:
The assets on which you want the whitelist rule to take effect. Valid values:

*   ALL: all assets
*   Others: selected assets
